item.title: Naan
item.description:
Makes 8 smallish naan breads. Total time: ~2 hours. Adapted from King Arthur Baking.

Ingredients

Dough:

  • 180g all-purpose flour
  • 90g bread flour
  • 142g warm water
  • 5 Tbsp [71g] plain full-fat Greek yogurt
  • 2 Tbsp [28g] ghee or butter, melted
  • 1.5 tsp instant yeast
  • 1 tsp sugar
  • 1 tsp salt

Topping:

  • 2 Tbsp [28g] ghee or butter, melted (for brushing)
  • (optional) fresh chopped cilantro

Directions

Combine all ingredients for the dough in large bowl and mix (it will probably be too small of an amount to use a stand mixer). A shaggy dough should form.

item.title: Baked Okra
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1.5-2 lbs fresh okra (or 2 16oz bags frozen okra)
  • 1 Tbsp vegetable oil
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp fresh ground pepper
  • 1 tsp tumeric
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • 1/2 tsp cumin
  • 1/2 tsp coriander
  • 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper

Directions

Preheat oven to 450F (or 425F for convection).

If using fresh okra: wash and dry, trim both ends off, and cut into roughly 1/2inch chunks. If using frozen okra: no prep needed, use frozen directly from bag.

item.title: Butter + Tandoori Chicken
item.description:
Ingredients

For the chicken:

  • 3 lbs of boneless chicken thighs
  • 1/2 cup greek yogurt
  • 3 Tbsp lemon juice
  • 2 Tbsp white wine vinegar (rice vinegar also works)
  • 6 Tbsp neutral oil
  • 1 small piece fresh ginger, grated
  • 6 Tbsp Sharwood’s Tandoori Spice (see mix below)
  • 1 Tbsp fenugreek leaves
  • 2 tsp kosher salt

Sharwood spice mix:

  • 3 Tbsp paprika (try to find a paprika which is not smokey, American grocery stores might have it in the Hispanic foods section)
  • 1 Tbsp ground turmeric
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp ground nutmeg
  • 1 tsp cayenne pepper
  • 1 tsp ground ginger
  • 1 tsp ground coriander
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 1 tsp ground cloves

item.title: Indian Style Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1.5 cups basmati rice
  • 1 small onion, thinly sliced
  • 2 Tbsp neutral oil (or ghee)
  • 1 whole cinnamon stick
  • 2 pods green cardamom
  • 2 whole cloves
  • 1 Tbsp cumin seed
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 2.5 cups water

Instructions

Rinse rice. Place rice in a bowl with enough water to cover, let sit while doing remaining steps. If using a rice cooker, you can use the rice cooker bowl for this.

item.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
item.description:
Ingredients

For the Chicken:

  • 1/2 cup whole milk yogurt
  • 1.5 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp turmeric
  • 1 tsp garam masala (okay to substitute curry powder)
  • 1 tsp ground coriander
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 2-inch chunks

For the Sauce:

  • 4 tablespoons unsalted butter
  • 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped
  • 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh ginger
  • 1.25 tsp garam masala (okay to substitute curry powder)
  • 1.25 tsp ground coriander
  • 1.75 tsp ground cumin
  • 1 (14-oz) can crushed tomatoes
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp sugar
  • 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper
  • 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro

Instructions

In a bowl large enough to hold the chicken, whisk together the yogurt, salt and spices. Add the chicken and mix until it is evenly coated. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or overnight.
